intro: Merissa Stilwell is a young human townsperson residing at Northshire Abbey within Elwynn Forest. Standing near the abbey, she offers a cheerful greeting and a helping hand to the newcomers training in Northshire Valley.

p: Standing at Northshire Abbey, Merissa Stilwell greets the fresh recruits who arrive in Northshire Valley. For wandering novices, she offers simple hospitality and practical advice on resting up and getting oriented. Sharing a surname with notable craftsmen and homesteaders across the kingdom—such as the blacksmith Jordan Stilwell and the Westfall defender Daphne Stilwell—she remains a peaceful local face amidst the kingdom's rising tensions.
